detected_errors.description: System signal indicates unexpected termination or state mismatch.

tickets.possible_root_cause: Resource contention or unhandled promise rejection in the application runtime.
tickets.user_resolution:
1. Restart the impacted application service.
2. Verify network connection and firewall rules.
3. Retry the operation with standard user privileges.
tickets.technical_resolution:
1. Inspect active processes: `Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10`
2. Clear temporary cache directory.
3. Restart background daemon and monitor `/var/log` or Windows Event Log.

tickets.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Saturation & Backend 503 Outage
tickets.problem_summary: Application backend experienced repeated 503 Service Unavailable drops due to PostgreSQL pool exhaustion. Correlated server logs at 14:22 UTC with Grafana spike and client-side error dialog.

detected_errors.error_code: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
detected_errors.description: Max connections limit (100) reached, blocking incoming microservice queries.
Payment gateway checkout timed out during database acquire phase.

tickets.possible_root_cause: Node.js connection pool size set to default 10 without PgBouncer multiplexing; background cron job spawned 40 concurrent workers holding idle transactions.

evidence_correlations.connection_details: Log timestamp 14:22:18 corresponds exactly to the 503 response timestamp on the checkout UI

tickets.user_resolution:
1. Refresh browser after 2 minutes.
2. Clear local browser session storage.
3. The engineering team has scaled connection capacity and stabilized the checkout service.
tickets.technical_resolution:
1. Adjust postgresql.conf max_connections = 300
2. Deploy PgBouncer in transaction pooling mode:
   pool_mode = transaction
   default_pool_size = 50
   reserve_pool_size = 10
3. Set idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 30000

tickets.title: Windows Kernel BSOD 0x0000003B Graphic Subsystem Crash
tickets.problem_summary: Workstation encountered sudden blue screen (SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION) during high-load render task. Minidump correlates with audio voice description of fan throttling.

detected_errors.description: Kernel memory fault initiated in nvlddmkm.sys driver code offset 0x43a210.
User reported high pitch acoustic noise immediately preceding screen freeze.

tickets.possible_root_cause: Outdated NVIDIA Studio Driver 551.23 interacting with Windows 11 24H2 memory integrity virtualization (VBS).

evidence_correlations.connection_details: Acoustic report matches the kernel dump timestamp within a 3-second window

tickets.user_resolution:
1. Boot workstation into Safe Mode by holding Shift while restarting.
2. Download latest certified GPU driver package.
3. Run clean installation wizard and reboot normally.
tickets.technical_resolution:
1. Execute DDU (Display Driver Uninstaller) in Safe Mode with /clean /restart flags.
2. Set Windows Registry TdrDelay:
   [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers]
   "TdrDelay"=dword:00000008
3. Install clean WHQL driver v572.16 without GeForce Experience telemetries.

knowledge_base.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool & Max Connections Troubleshooting Guide
knowledge_base.content_summary: Comprehensive guide on resolving FATAL: remaining connection slots reserved for non-replication superuser connections. Covers PgBouncer pooling parameters, pool size formula: pool_size = ((core_count * 2) + effective_spindle_count), and TCP keepalive tuning.
